threepl.simulator

Class SimCli

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimCli
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimUserInt

    public class SimCli
extends java.lang.Object
implements SimUserInt
    SimCli provide the command line interface to the threepl simulator. It provides a command loop with prompt, and various methods for printing normal output and errors.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh
